name: eligibility_engine
description: Return a preliminary synthetic eligibility screening for a household against one program category. Use program=food-assistance or program=health-coverage. Pass the household attributes returned by household_lookup. Returns a screening result (likely-eligible, likely-ineligible, or needs-review) with its basis. This is a screening, not an official determination.

program.description: Must be exactly one of: food-assistance, health-coverage

household_size.description: Number of people in the household, from household_lookup
